description: Source code for a WebSocket deflate stream fuzzer used for testing WebSocket deflate stream implementation via fuzzing.

classes.name: WebSocketFuzzedStream
classes.description: A mock WebSocketStream implementation used for fuzzing WebSocket frames.

methods.name: WebSocketFuzzedStream::ReadFrames
methods.description: Reads frames from the fuzzed data provider, creating WebSocket frames for testing.

methods.name: WebSocketFuzzedStream::WriteFrames
methods.description: Stub method returning error, as writing is not used in fuzzing.

methods.name: WebSocketFuzzedStream::GetSubProtocol
methods.description: Returns an empty string for subprotocol.

methods.name: WebSocketFuzzedStream::GetExtensions
methods.description: Returns an empty string for extensions.

methods.name: WebSocketFuzzedStream::CreateFrame
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket frame with randomized header and payload based on fuzzed data.

methods.name: WebSocketDeflateStreamFuzz
methods.description: Sets up WebSocket deflate parameters and runs the deflate stream with fuzzed data.
